data.body: Patch set 1 of Gerrit 3138 got Verified -1. Two integration-tier failures that make verify does not run: (1) test_a3_repair_aborts_when_push_fails_leaving_pretag_for_rollback asserted the old abort; (2) the bare-repository portability guard flagged my new test addressing a bare remote via -C. Probing (1) showed the plain merge-and-retry was UNSAFE: in the two-clone race, B's concurrent comment on the ticket A had just rebuilt predates A's new SNAPSHOT, so the merge produced an ORPHAN_EVENT and the retry published it (fsck after: 'ORPHAN_EVENT ... pre-snapshot event not captured'). Reworked: after a rejection the batch merges, re-repairs its tickets on the merged state, commits, then pushes. The integration test now asserts the race ends with a clean fsck, B's comment kept, and A equal to the remote; removing only the re-repair step makes it fail on that ORPHAN_EVENT. Full integration tier locally: 189 passed. Commit a35406ebf8e; make verify running before patch set 2.
